findings.evidence: Kolmogorov.lean:73 `end TauCeti`, :75 `namespace Matrix.PosSemidef`, :298 `end Matrix.PosSemidef` — a top-level extension of an upstream namespace. Mathlib puts the corresponding construction in its own namespace instead: mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Reproducing.lean:55 `namespace RKHS`, :284 `abbrev OfKernel`. The PR description states this placement was chosen to preserve dot notation; that convenience does not justify occupying an upstream namespace with declarations only TauCeti defines.
findings.fix: Declare these under `namespace TauCeti` alongside `TauCeti.positiveDefiniteKernelOperator` in the same file (e.g. `TauCeti.kolmogorovSpace hK`, `TauCeti.kolmogorovFeature hK`, `TauCeti.inner_kolmogorovFeature`), taking `hK : Matrix.PosSemidef K` as an ordinary explicit argument as `posSemidef_normSq_le` already does, and drop the `posSemidef_` stutter from `posSemidef_positiveDefiniteKernelOperator`. Update the `Main declarations` list at lines 33-42 accordingly.
findings.issue: `namespace Matrix.PosSemidef` is opened at top level (line 75, after `end TauCeti` at line 73) and declares TauCeti's entire Kolmogorov API into Mathlib's namespace: `KolmogorovSpace`, `kolmogorovFeature`, `kolmogorovFeature_dense`, `kolmogorovIsometry`, `kolmogorovIsometry_apply/_unique/_surjective`, `kolmogorovEquiv`, `kolmogorovEquiv_apply`, `posSemidef_positiveDefiniteKernelOperator`, plus six `@[simp]` lemmas (135, 149, 156, 234, 289). Every `Matrix.PosSemidef` hypothesis in the ecosystem now carries these as dot-notation members, and Mathlib's own RKHS development — which this file builds on — is actively adding constructions of exactly this kind, so `Matrix.PosSemidef.kolmogorov*` is a live collision surface, not a hypothetical one. It also produces the stutter `hK.posSemidef_positiveDefiniteKernelOperator` (line 85), and it is inconsistent with every sibling consequence of the same predicate, all of which stay in `TauCeti` (`TauCeti.posSemidef_normSq_le` at Kernel/Bounds.lean:66, `posSemidef_eq_zero_of_apply_self_eq_zero_left` at :91, `map_neg_eq_conj_of_posSemidef` at :145).

summary: The predicate migration is clean — no compatibility aliases survive, bodies stay unexposed, and `posSemidef_iff` keeps the characteristic intro/elim API. But the whole Kolmogorov construction is now declared inside Mathlib's `Matrix.PosSemidef` namespace, which is not TauCeti's to extend with a TauCeti-specific construction Mathlib itself files under `RKHS`.
